name: Kuonji Jin
source:
Graduate schooler, majoring archaeology. Have great interest in supernatural phenomena.
He is puzzled by Kiri's change of heart, but when he finds out that the succubus is the cause, he accepts it and agrees to donate his semen.

[Translated from the [url=https://hamham-soft.net/imosucc/]official website[/url]]
